name: place-directory
title: Place Directory
description: A map-backed listing site: a `place` document type plotted as pins on a Next.js map (powers hundesteder.no).

env.description: Barkpark API base the frontend fetches from (server-side).
Read-only, workspace-bound token minted at bootstrap. Server-only — never exposed to the browser.
Flips the web demo's landing page into the places map.

Shared HMAC secret for ISR cache revalidation: the instance's webhook dispatcher signs with it and the site's /api/barkpark/webhook handler verifies with it. Generated at bootstrap and bound to a disabled webhook endpoint whose URL is wired once the site deploys. Server-only.
